info.title: v2.payment.get_billing_transaction_info
info.description: This API is applicable for Cross Border (CB) sellers only to get the detailed payout transaction data, both released and to-be released transaction can be found in here

post.description: This API is applicable for Cross Border (CB) sellers only to get the detailed payout transaction data, both released and to-be released transaction can be found in here

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is "". If data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: encrypted_payout_ids
parameters.description: encrypted_payout_id get from API: v2.get_payout_info when encrypted_payout_id provided and billing_transaction_info_type=2, we will return the "released" billing items under this payout. when encrypted_payout_id not provided, we will return the "to release" billing items under hasn't form payout yet Max length: 100

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://open.admin.uat.shopee.io/api/v2/payment/get_billing_transaction_info?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "billing_transaction_info_type": 1,
    "cursor": "\\"\\"",
    "encrypted_payout_ids": [
        "10376329180766",
        "637926329180767"
    ],
    "page_size": 100
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

import requests
import json

url = "https://open.admin.uat.shopee.io/api/v2/payment/get_billing_transaction_info?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp"

payload=json.dumps({
  "billing_transaction_info_type": 1,
  "cursor": "\"\"",
  "encrypted_payout_ids": [
    "10376329180766",
    "637926329180767"
  ],
  "page_size": 100
})
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.RPCRequest("POST",url,headers=headers, data=payload, allow_redirects=False)

print(response.text)
